main_text.p: fervavit. Apostolus Paulus Rom. 15: 8. omnia complectitur quæ Calvinus de Christo in officio mediatorio conside-rato, dixit: Illud autem dico, inquit, Jesum Christum ministrum fuisse circumcisionis pro Dei veritate, ut confirmaret promissiones Patrum.
main_text.head: DEFENSIO
Pro Calvino Arianismi accusato.

p.i: Respondebunt forsan Calvinistæ nimis iniquè censeri verba Calvini, neque recte illum inde Arianum probari quod optime defendi hæc possint catholica distinctione, quâ Christum confitemur Deum & hominem, secundùm quam distinctionem, si dicatur Calvinus locutus fuisse, de Christo tantùm ut homine, apparebunt textus locaq; præcedentia calumniosè adducta.

page.notes: The fleuron ornament between the text and DEFENSIO is not transcribed. The initial R is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "Respondebunt" as "Respondebunt" in italic. Some words in the printed italic passage ("neq;", "locaq;") are read with a macron-like abbreviation; the final line ends with a hyphenated word continued on the next page.
